atlas-taliesin.providerDescription: Exterior of "Taliesin", the house and office near Spring Green, Wisconsin, designed by Frank Lloyd Wright to serve as his family residence and studio. The building is a contributing structure in the Taliesin Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1973, and was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1976.  Today, it is utilized as a museum, offering tours and interpretation of Frank Lloyd Wright’s life and work.
